ops.text: tests/test_transcripts_registration.py::TestMcpTool::test_mcp_tool_hits_the_same_slot fails when its module runs without the rest of the suite. The autouse deny_installed_processes fixture (tests/conftest.py:60-73) swaps subprocess.Popen for a plain function, and a first-time import of mcp.server.stdio then evaluates subprocess.Popen[bytes] and raises TypeError. In the full suite another test imports mcp first, so it passes. Hit on 2026-10-12 while running focused warming tests for PR #360; unrelated to that diff.
